boxes.meaning: to make up after a quarrel

english.note: Use this specifically when people repair a relationship and make peace after falling out.
Use this when people reconcile and become friendly again after a disagreement.

examples.english: They finally resolve their differences after their argument.
examples.traditional: 佢哋鬧交之後終於和好喇。

examples.english: They finally managed to heal their rift after arguing.
